notes: Kozjak’s pale rockfill dam with its 302.80 m mapped crest road, circular overflow, white red-roof tower, intake rails and lower two-unit generating complex with ochre walls, red gabled roofs and outdoor electrical equipment. The standard sampled reservoir is 9.65 m above the operator’s maximum pool, submerging the overflow rim. Reference and standard fixtures document this difference; native fit remains pending. The main crest is mapped. Powerhouse footprint, switchyard, gallery, intake-rail position and local equipment sizes are approximate exterior layouts from ordinary photos and the native outfall point. Rockfill cross-sections, buried foundations and cliff interfaces are approximated against standard terrain. Water, gates and exterior electrical equipment are static. The machinery interior and buried conduits are outside the model.
